scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build packages/dial-core-wasm --target bundler --out-dir pkg --out-name dial-core
scripts.build:wasm:node: wasm-pack build packages/dial-core-wasm --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node --out-name dial-core
scripts.build:wasm:web: wasm-pack build packages/dial-core-wasm --target web --out-dir pkg-web --out-name dial-core && node -e "var fs=require('fs'),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/dial-core-wasm/pkg-web/package.json','utf8'));p.name='dial-core-wasm-web';fs.writeFileSync('packages/dial-core-wasm/pkg-web/package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n')"
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:node && npm run build:wasm:web
